gemma.note: 2.3B effective; about 5.1B including embeddings. Full upstream checkpoint, not a 2 GB quantization.

laya.role: candidate ranking, experimental until domain evaluated
laya.note: English 421M checkpoint only. No claim of Jev parity; upstream reports weak zero-shot typed-decisions performance.

embedding.note: 740M full checkpoint; text-only loading is 270M. Use float32 or bfloat16, not float16.

timesfm.note: 2.5 selected for small size and Apache weights. Not a generic action-conditioned world model.
